title: Media query feature types
learningObjectives: Explain media query feature types and use the relevant layout or responsive features.

understand.concept: Media queries evaluate media types and features. Common features include width, height, orientation, aspect-ratio, hover, pointer, resolution, colour scheme, and reduced motion. A query can combine conditions with and, or, not, and comma-separated alternatives.
understand.whyItMatters: Choosing the correct feature makes responsive behaviour reflect the user's environment rather than a device brand. Some features describe capabilities or preferences, not screen dimensions.
understand.analogy: A media query asks a question about the environment before applying a set of styles.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; actual scroll, sizing, and media-query behaviour follows browser layout rules.

explain.narrative: The panel changes its border in landscape orientation and its palette when the user prefers a dark colour scheme.

practise.guidedTask: Write one query for viewport width, one for orientation, and one for a user preference. Explain what each condition detects.
